setup_vasp_calc_mof: create a VASP calculator for MOF relaxation and write input files to a directory
setup_vasp_mof_and_ads: create a VASP calculator for MOF plus adsorbate relaxation with atom positions only
run_setup_vasp_calc_mof: run the module to set up VASP input files for a MOF structure from a CIF file
run_setup_vasp_mof_and_ads: run the module to set up VASP input files for a MOF with adsorbates from a CIF file
refactor_setup_vasp_calc_mof: refactor setup_vasp_calc_mof to support configurable k-point mesh and energy cutoff parameters
